services.name: Flight Deck
services.desc: On Midway's Flight Deck, find out firsthand what it takes to take off and land at the world’s most compact airport. With over 20 restored naval aircraft populating the massive Flight Deck, you can walk up and touch some of the fighters, bombers and helicopters that took naval aviation into the jet age. Directly beneath the bustle of the Flight Deck, tour through Pilot Ready Rooms, sample the amenities of the Captain’s Inport Cabin and discover how Midway’s Admiral fought Operation Desert Storm in his high-tech command center. services.name: Meatball Exhibit
services.desc: Experience the expanse of a floating Hangar Deck, examine vintage World War II-era aircraft, and learn about Midway’s Carrier Air Wing evolving history. Experience the riveting multimedia Battle of Midway Theater and the Combat Information Center. Inspect expertly restored WWII-era aircraft and explore a special display on Midway's humanitarian rescue off Saigon. Climb into actual aircraft cockpit trainers and live the life of an aviator in our Flight Simulators. services.desc: At these affordable ticket prices, nothing compares to the Midway for a day filled with excitement, thrills, and lasting memories for the whole family. In fact, the only thing better is an Annual Pass or Annual Membership so you can enjoy unlimited visits and special privileges. Either way, you’re in for some real action! Midway Members & Annual Pass Holders: You are welcome aboard at any time. You do not need to reserve online-dated tickets. Simply bring your membership card or Annual Pass and a photo ID to the museum entrance. Ticket is for US Veteran individuals only.
